units: metres; glTF X right Y up Z front; same origin as proof
builderOwnership: shared contract, public exports, application, tests, browser evidence and journal

assets.environment.glb: Only terrain, planting, bridge/far landing, and environmental practicals; no base/robots/labels/cargo on court. Reuse existing environment geometry/materials.
assets.base-command.glb: Existing curved twin bays with illuminated roof identity and added station detailing.
assets.base-relay.glb: Asymmetric communications silhouette, taller rear service/communications section and stepped offset roof, same occupied floor/socket contract.
assets.base-foundry.glb: Broader hangar/service crown with low utility shoulder/silo arrangement; visibly distinct at world size, same occupied floor/socket contract.

ambientMaterials: ambient_screen_* and ambient_sensor_* for gentle pulse; practical_* for warm window/entry/marker illumination. Keep materials distinct from task status.
materialRequirements: Portable embedded PBR, real small modeled lights/sensors/computer housings. Coloured recessed roof disc/ring like annotation, plus warm window and entry detail. Builder applies project palette and runtime pulse; neutral material source for recolouring.

worker.origin: feet; builder owns scaling, rings and label height

cargo.requirement: Enlarge source objects from their ground contact; preserve readable handles/recesses and keep sockets/routes unobstructed

footprintLimit.courtyard: retain existing 27m wide front court; grounded plinth; no bridge connection changes

metadata: kit-metadata.json: per asset filename, bounds, group/material inventory, baseLightPositions, environmentLightPositions; retain original cameras/shoreline/routes/sockets or explicitly record adjusted sockets. Merge static geometry by group/material only during export; editable .blend stays separate.
preserve: Existing accepted coastal environment; no new rock/plant campaign. Two-area cutaway remains valid in each base. No actors, fixture IDs or progress baked into assets.
proof: Three different structures across projects, independent colour choices, daylight/night and close exterior detail evidence from actual browser. Offline rendering is only producer QA.
